title: Sharp planar Turán bounds for quasi-double stars
summary: We study $W$-free planar graphs for $W\in\{W_{2,4},W_{2,5},W_{3,4}\}$, where the quasi-double star $W_{h,k}$ is obtained from a three-vertex path by attaching $h$ leaves to one endpoint and $k$ leaves to the other. We prove that every $W_{2,4}$-free planar graph on $n$ vertices has at most $9n/4$ edges, and the bound is attained whenever $8\mid n$. This determines the planar Turán density of $W_{2,4}$ as $9/4$.
